correctness.rationale: An orbit-barycenter affine inverse identifies actual geometric fixed points with E_m for all n. Central triple obstruction is exactly the first pair, and outer obstructions are consecutive triples. An augmented matching partitions by vertex 2, uses toggle of vertex 1 on one fiber and induction on E_{m-2} on the other; all cross arrows point in one direction. Only the even-indexed face survives for even m. Removing the empty-face pairing yields one critical vertex plus the single predicted higher cell, proving contractibility or the integral sphere homotopy type. Standalone direct face/homology and acyclicity programs passed their reported finite ranges.
